name: Tsabo Tavoc
description: A Yawgmoth minion whose plagues and shock troops devastated Dominarian nations.

timeline.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo Tavoc and Gerrard face off.
timeline.quote: "I think I can kill you," replied Gerrard.

citation.text: Dueling Grounds (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Benalia becomes the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexian slayers.
timeline.quote: Benalia was only the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers.

citation.text: Phyrexian Slayer (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The brothers attack Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians at Koilos in a pincer; Agnate fails while Thaddeus breaks through.
timeline.quote: Agnate's forces fared badly and were unable to force a breakthrough.

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tavoc captures Thaddeus in a trap and Urza names Eladamri to replace him, who bests Agnate.
timeline.quote: Only after Eladamri had bested Agnate in combat

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Koilos is retaken; Agnate finds Thaddeus vivisected and ends his misery.
timeline.quote: Agnate fulfilled Thaddeus' last wish and ended his brother's misery.

citation.text: "Agnate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Benalia is the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's killers during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion , Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers.

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo Tavoc manipulates Gerrard's grief to control his mind until his friends and Karn free him.
timeline.quote: Tsabo Tavoc , manipulated Gerrard's grief over Hanna to gain control over his mind

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Portals open over Benalia releasing a Phyrexian armada; the crew closes some but is jailed with the Blind Seer.
timeline.quote: The book begins with Weatherlight flying over Benalia when suddenly portals begin to open in the sky, through which a Phyrexian armada is coming.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians kill everyone in Benalia City and decimate Urza's armies; Hanna is wounded and contracts Phyrexian Plague.
timeline.quote: Orim diagnoses Hanna with Phyrexian Plague.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza and Barrin bring out the metathran generals Thaddeus and Agnate and begin a stalemated siege of the Caves of Koilos.
timeline.quote: it quickly turns into a siege with neither side being able to turn the tides of battle to its favor.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thaddeus is captured and vivisected by Tavoc; during Eladamri's duel with Agnate, Hanna dies.
timeline.quote: but during the duel, Hanna passes away.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Koilos the Weatherlight crew is overcome; Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief to control his mind, and Agnate mercy kills Thaddeus.
timeline.quote: Tavoc uses Gerrard's grief over Hanna's death to gain control of his mind

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn gives up his pacifism, Gerrard breaks free, and with Karn grievously wounds Tavoc, who flees through the portal before Gerrard closes it.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Karn wound Tavoc grievously, and the Phyrexian only barely manages to flee through the portal before Gerrard closes it.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Confronting Tsabo Tavoc in Koilos, Karn's memories return and he helps Gerrard kill her.
timeline.quote: He was instrumental in helping Gerrard kill Tavoc

citation.text: "Karn", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Portal ships enter over Benalia and the first wave of the Phyrexian Invasion begins under Tsabo Tavoc.
timeline.quote: The ships entered Dominaria over the sky of Benalia

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo Tavoc is beaten and badly wounded by Gerrard and Karn and retreats to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Tsabo Tavoc had been beaten and badly wounded by Gerrard and Karn and retreated to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay begins the second wave, and Tsabo Tavoc is punished and eaten by Crovax.
timeline.quote: ultimately being eaten by Crovax

citation.text: "Phyrexia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian forces led by Tsabo Tavoc overwhelm Benalia and establish a foothold, though prisoners from Atrivak Mounds are rescued.
timeline.quote: established a foothold on Dominaria

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Koilos, Thaddeus is dissected by Tsabo, and Eladamri and Agnate destroy the Gate to Phyrexia; Thaddeus and Hanna die.
timeline.quote: together they destroyed the Gate to Phyrexia

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "First stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Rathi Overlay brings Rath's Phyrexian legions onto Dominaria, and Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc for failing at Koilos.
timeline.quote: Crovax killed Tsabo Tavoc as punishment for her failure at Koilos

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dominaria's forces unite to push Yawgmoth back during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: All of the forces of Dominaria banded against Yawgmoth and tried to push him back.

citation.text: "Urza", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth launches his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth finally launched his full-scale invasion of Dominaria in 4205 AR.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Urza takes the Weatherlight and metathran to Urborg; Crovax cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc.
timeline.quote: Crovax , the leader of the invasion, cannibalizes Tsabo Tavoc for her failures.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria is led at Urborg by Tsabo Tavoc and accompanying horrors.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria was led by Tsabo Tavoc and accompanying horrors.

citation.text: "Horror", section "Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo Tavoc declares that whatever Yawgmoth marks dies.
timeline.quote: Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies.

citation.text: Annihilate (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Benalia is the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers.

citation.text: "Benalia City", section "Invaded by Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raddeus and Leda are killed by Tsabo Tavoc's minions and reanimated as skeletons.
timeline.quote: Killed by Tsabo Tavoc 's minions

citation.text: "Clan Capashen", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Crovax kills Tsabo Tavoc in the Stronghold's throne room, solidifying his rule.
timeline.quote: Crovax emerged victorious, killing Tsabo

citation.text: "Rathi Overlay", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Each leads part of the army in a pincer attack on Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians at Koilos; Tsabo intercepts Thaddeus's bond and lures him into a trap.
timeline.quote: Agnate and Thaddeus each led part of the army in a pincer attack against Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexians

citation.text: "Thaddeus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thaddeus is captured and experimented upon by Tsabo Tavoc, confirming the Metathran and Phyrexians are alike.
timeline.quote: the Metathran and Phyrexians were more alike than different

citation.text: "Thaddeus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo fights Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia.
timeline.quote: Tsabo fought Gerrard Capashen and the rest of the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Koilos Tsabo ambushes Thaddeus and has him vivisected.
timeline.quote: She then had him vivisected to see if Phyrexia could benefit from Urza 's work on the metathran.

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo mind-controls Gerrard, making him think she is his mother.
timeline.quote: Tsabo mind-controlled Gerrard, making him believe she was his "mother".

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karn rips off several of Tsabo's legs and Gerrard, helped by Squee, stabs her.
timeline.quote: Karn broke his oath of nonviolence and ripped several of the Phyrexian's legs off.

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tsabo is repaired in Phyrexia, then given to Crovax, who rips her apart and eats her.
timeline.quote: Crovax ripped her apart and ate her, taking Tsabo's strength for himself.

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Annihilate (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
